opportunities.name: GitHub user lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com summarizing followers, top repo and latest post.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter
Open mail compose, enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body with followers, top repo (stars, language), latest post

opportunities.name: Person Wikipedia lookup + Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view a company's site on the Wayback Machine for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia
Go to Wayback Machine and enter the domain
Pick the year and a snapshot date
Read headline text on the archived page
Open notes, add new note combining person facts and site snapshot, press Enter
